status: Proposed complete source-fit authoring programme for all 36 scientific-process expectations. Required public checks and preservation qualified; independent source-duty review remains part of ordinary integration review. No learner performance, default-branch acceptance or downstream publication is claimed.

source.publisherContextReadScope: Full textual scientific/engineering-process sections on printed pages 69–79 and safety on pages 80–81 read. All three process diagrams on printed pages 71/74/77 (PDF pages 72/75/78) rendered and visually inspected. Fresh retained API cores read for all 36 positions.

interpretation: Research can use firsthand observations and source accounts, with age-appropriate source credibility/recording and conclusions. It is not an advanced bibliography inventory imposed on every grade.
Experimentation and design require actual enactment, observations and reasoned revision. Prepared protocols account for authoring coverage; they do not claim any pupil has performed them.

Publisher process components allow multiple entry points and are not a fixed universal linear checklist or demand every component in every grade. Grade/programme differences do not create difficulty-specific topics.
Repeated investigations and experiments across all four content strands must be accounted for. One shadow/temperature task cannot certify all grade science process duties.

Health/safety includes suitable protective equipment/clothing, tools/materials and established adult/school procedures. Actual suitability is assessed for selected tasks; no learner legal-inventory or hazardous demonstration is introduced.

Communication must use scientific vocabulary and a form suited to audience/purpose, with the actual findings rather than decorative terminology. Existing full English writing/vocabulary claims remain separately assessed.

Grade1 matter-and-energy context is energy in everyday change; the material water-drop comparison belongs to the structures/materials design investigation. A small force/motion observation is not a complete energy measurement or a new force mastery claim.

nextProgramme: Prepare coherent grade/strand protocols using already qualified resources where they actually meet the scientific-process duty; inspect complete existing claims/guides/readiness before any scoped changes. No new topics proposed.

resourceScope.publishedScienceSource: The retained Ontario 2022 curriculum content sections for the four named grade strands are the selected published-source resource. Pupils attribute it and distinguish its general content from their own firsthand method/results. Fictional trial/advertisement accounts are explicitly source-assessment practice, not observed scientific data.
resourceScope.localityBoundary: These bounded classroom model protocols do not require unselected local community facts. Actual equipment, school safety and accessibility remain delivery checks; no experiment is claimed performed. The optional accessible school-patch observation in Grade4 is distinct from the required actual indoor model, and a fictional field packet is never called a real observation.
resourceScope.physicalEducationBoundary: Grade5 body-systems investigation uses an intact safe mechanical air model. No exercise, fitness test or personal physiology/body data is required. Optional ordinary observations are voluntary and do not certify excluded Physical Education or longitudinal health outcomes.
